current_implementation_boundaries.trajectory: Local-risk acceptance plus periodic diagnostics; without active localization risks only alpha=0 is considered.
current_implementation_boundaries.clips: Three consecutive visible frames with finite positive boxes; one initialization, two predictions, one propagated crop. No demonstrated occlusion recovery or long-term drift result.
current_implementation_boundaries.risk: Task mean before positive-part risk; scale abs(before).clamp_min(1e-8). Per-sample cancellation and denominator effects are source-derived limitations, not verified performance bottlenecks.
current_implementation_boundaries.correction: Ridge Gram solve in restricted risk-gradient space plus amplitude cap and actual forward candidate checks; no all-target non-degradation or Pareto guarantee.
current_implementation_boundaries.ablation: modules_enabled currently records names; it does not disable the actual module calls or state updates.
current_implementation_boundaries.distance_evidence: 589-update fixed-trial diagnostic: 26/27 risk events have a locally improving correction and would select nonzero alpha without distance. Counterfactual only, not new trained benchmark gain.

research_claim_boundaries: Do not attribute public-reference improvement solely to the modules.
Do not optimize correction frequency as the final objective.
Do not interpret training losses, risk statistics or preview checks as benchmark scores.
Repeated development use of current tests must be disclosed; tests never enter training update checks.
Three DDP GPUs are not three independent seeds; frames are not independent statistical trials.
No all-benchmarks-first or SOTA claim without comparable protocols and evidence.
weight_retention: Keep one necessary active recovery checkpoint while training; after complete evaluation retain only the best measured method weight. Preserve required public inputs, source, logs, metrics, hashes and retirement receipts.

hardware_constraints.supersedes: Both configured250W gate and actual temperature/power pause-resume control.
